stories.title: Spread Btp-Bund oltre quota 100 su Borsa Italiana: è la prima volta dal 2025. Francia a 119

en.title: BTP-Bund spread exceeds 100 on Borsa Italiana: first time since 2025. France at 119
en.summary: The Italian ten-year bond yield reached 4.59%, its highest level in three years, causing the BTP-Bund spread to surpass 100 basis points for the first time this year.

stories.title: Da Eni tetto alle bollette gas e luce, sconto del 30% rispetto offerta base

en.title: Eni caps gas and electricity bills with 30% discount from base offer
en.summary: Eni is offering a price-locked plan for two years starting October 1st with potential savings of up to 200 euros compared to its standard rate.

stories.title: Garlasco, sulla revisione della condanna a Stasi “tempi lunghi”: la procura generale attende atti

en.title: Garlasco, conviction review of Stasi faces "lengthy timescales": prosecutor general awaits documents
en.summary: The prosecutor general is waiting for documents regarding a potential conviction review in the Garlasco case, with Stasi's defense expected to file the formal request after investigation closure.

stories.title: Wanna Marchi e la figlia premiate a Roma: "Dal carcere al Campidoglio, che strana la vita"

en.title: Wanna Marchi and daughter awarded in Rome: "From prison to Campidoglio, how strange life is"
en.summary: Wanna Marchi and her daughter Stefania Nobile, both convicted for fraud-related organized crime, received recognition for their books at a private event in Rome's Campidoglio hall.

stories.title: Anche Q8 annuncia un tetto al prezzo dei carburanti

en.title: Q8 also announces a cap on fuel prices
en.summary: Q8 has announced a price ceiling for fuel amid growing protests over rising costs. Industry group Assopetroli is seeking discussions with the government on the matter.

stories.title: Wanna Marchi premiata in Campidoglio, la figlia: “Rosicate. La cultura siamo noi, non Pirandello”

en.title: Wanna Marchi awarded at Campidoglio, her daughter: "You are envious. Culture is us, not Pirandello"
en.summary: Wanna Marchi received a cultural award at Rome's Campidoglio with her daughter, sparking controversy on social media. The daughter defended their recognition and criticized those opposing their presence at the ceremony.

stories.title: Wanna Marchi premiata in Campidoglio per la Cultura. E sui social scoppiano le polemiche

en.title: Wanna Marchi awarded at Campidoglio for Culture. Social media erupts with controversy
en.summary: Wanna Marchi received a cultural award at Rome's Campidoglio through an initiative by publisher Alessandro Gian Maria Ferri, prompting debate on social media platforms.

stories.title: Scontro tv tra il generale Garofano e i legali di Stasi su Garlasco: «Lei è scorretta». «Questo è un fatto di una gravità inaudita»

en.title: TV clash between General Garofano and Stasi's lawyers on Garlasco: "You are unfair". "This is a matter of unprecedented gravity"
en.summary: General Garofano and the legal representatives of Stasi engaged in a heated television debate regarding the Garlasco case during a program hosted by Massimo Giletti on Rai 3.

stories.title: Caso Garlasco, l’ex Ris Portera: “Non ho fatto io l’analisi del Dna sulla bici di Alberto Stasi”

en.title: Garlasco case, former RIS officer Portera: "I did not conduct the DNA analysis on Alberto Stasi's bicycle"
en.summary: A retired geneticist and former RIS official told prosecutors his name was only associated with a system access entry, denying he performed DNA analysis in the Garlasco case.

stories.title: Carburanti, anche Q8 accoglie l’invito del governo: tetto al prezzo di benzina e gasolio

en.title: Fuel, Q8 also accepts government's invitation: price cap on petrol and diesel
en.summary: Q8 has agreed to implement a 30-day price ceiling on fuel following government pressure, with Premier Meloni thanking Kuwait which controls the oil company. Truckers are protesting, demanding price reductions for those refueling outside official networks.

stories.title: Carburanti, lieve calo ma i prezzi restano alti: anche Q8 dice sì al tetto Video

en.title: Fuel, slight decline but prices remain high: Q8 also says yes to the price cap
en.summary: Q8 joined Eni and Ip in accepting a price cap on fuel, though prices remain elevated. Truckers and some oil companies are protesting against the increases, while the government pushes for broader discount implementation.

stories.title: A Wanna Marchi e Stefania Nobile il “Premio internazionale della cultura” in Campidoglio, è polemica

en.title: Wanna Marchi and Stefania Nobile receive "International Prize for Culture" at Campidoglio, controversy erupts
en.summary: Wanna Marchi and Stefania Nobile were awarded an international culture prize at Rome's Campidoglio for their published works, sparking public controversy.

stories.title: Tra asfalti, pavimentazioni sportive ed energia: cresce il riciclo gomma da pneumatici

en.title: Among asphalt, sports surfaces and energy: tire rubber recycling grows
en.summary: Recycling of used tire rubber is expanding, with the Ecopneus Consortium collecting 125,748 tonnes by August 30 this year for use in various applications.

stories.title: La sostenibilità come investimento: la strategia di Kering punta sull’acqua

en.title: Sustainability as investment: Kering's strategy focuses on water
en.summary: Kering's chief sustainability officer presented the company's approach to water management at a Rome forum, arguing that protecting ecosystems and managing resources efficiently strengthens supply chains and adds value to brands.

stories.title: Prezzi produzione industriale +2,4% ad agosto, +10,9% sull’anno. Pesa l’energia

en.title: Industrial production prices +2.4% in August, +10.9% year-on-year. Energy weighs
en.summary: Industrial production prices rose 2.4% month-on-month and 10.9% year-on-year in August, up from 7.7% growth in July, with energy costs being a significant factor.

stories.title: Fondi europei: dal 2028 conteranno i risultati, ai progetti servono nuove competenze

en.title: European funds: from 2028 results will count, projects need new skills
en.summary: The new European multiannual budget for 2028-2034 will introduce significant changes in both the amount of available resources and how they are distributed across policies and territories.

stories.title: Contratto terziario, via libera a piattaforma unica con 220 euro di aumento per 3 milioni di addetti

en.title: Tertiary sector contract, approval of single platform with 220 euro increase for 3 million employees
en.summary: Trade unions representing 3 million tertiary sector workers approved a unified agreement for contract renewal with employer associations, providing a 220 euro wage increase.
